findings.detail: Ruby Bidco Holdings Limited term-loan fair value is presented in the SOI under USD dollar columns, but fair_value_currency was stored as U_GBP from the investment currency/par context.
Jupiter Refuel Canada Buyer, Inc. term-loan fair value is presented in the SOI under USD dollar columns, but fair_value_currency was stored as U_CAD from the investment currency/par context.

Jupiter Refuel Canada Buyer, Inc. revolving-credit fair value is presented in the SOI as the fair-value amount while table 38 only identifies CAD as investment currency, so fair_value_currency should not be U_CAD.

rationale: FX02 is a real data error. The source separates investment/par currency from fair-value presentation: the SOI rows show the fair-value columns as USD dollar columns, while GBP/CAD appears as investment currency or par context. The stored fair_value_currency values U_GBP and U_CAD therefore reflect the wrong source field, not the valuation column's unit.
